blocks.text: OAS, Albay — The municipal government of Oas in Albay is investing P113 million in water system improvements, including a 1-million-liter reservoir in Barangay Balogo, to address long-standing supply problems and prepare for El Niño. Mayor John Kenneth Trinidad said P83 million had been allocated for water system projects under the 2025-2026 budget, with an additional P30 million proposed for 2027. Installation of the 1,000-cubic-meter reservoir is underway and is expected to be completed by December. It is intended to improve water storage, supply and pressure, particularly in lowland barangays where households have experienced poor water flow. Trinidad said the municipality […]...
